title: Spam
script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "MessagePanel"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- دکمه باز کردن
local open = Instance.new("TextButton")
open.Size = UDim2.new(0, 58, 0, 58)
open.Position = UDim2.new(1, -75, 0.5, -29)
open.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 120, 255)
open.Text = "💬"
open.TextSize = 27
open.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
open.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
open.Parent = gui

Instance.new("UICorner", open).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 18)

-- پنل
local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 290, 0, 350)
panel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -145, 0.5, -175)
panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 32, 52)
panel.Visible = false
panel.Parent = gui

Instance.new("UICorner", panel).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 20)

-- عنوان
local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -55, 0, 45)
title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 5)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "💬 ارسال پیام"
title.TextSize = 23
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
title.Parent = panel

-- دکمه بستن
local close = Instance.new("TextButton")
close.Size = UDim2.new(0, 38, 0, 38)
close.Position = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, 8)
close.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 70, 80)
close.Text = "✕"
close.TextSize = 20
close.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
close.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
close.Parent = panel

Instance.new("UICorner", close).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)

-- نوشته سازنده
local creator = Instance.new("TextLabel")
creator.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 25)
creator.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 45)
creator.BackgroundTransparency = 1
creator.Text = "ساخته شده توسط تیم Amir"
creator.TextSize = 15
creator.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
creator.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 180, 255)
creator.Parent = panel

-- متن پیام
local message = Instance.new("TextBox")
message.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 45)
message.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 75)
message.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 58, 85)
message.PlaceholderText = "📝 متن پیام..."
message.Text = ""
message.TextSize = 17
message.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
message.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
message.ClearTextOnFocus = false
message.Parent = panel

Instance.new("UICorner", message).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)

-- تعداد
local count = Instance.new("TextBox")
count.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 45)
count.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 130)
count.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 58, 85)
count.PlaceholderText = "🔢 تعداد (حداکثر 1000)"
count.Text = "1"
count.TextSize = 17
count.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
count.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
count.ClearTextOnFocus = false
count.Parent = panel

Instance.new("UICorner", count).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)

-- شروع
local start = Instance.new("TextButton")
start.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 50)
start.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 185)
start.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(65, 200, 120)
start.Text = "▶ شروع"
start.TextSize = 20
start.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
start.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
start.Parent = panel

Instance.new("UICorner", start).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)

-- توقف
local stop = Instance.new("TextButton")
stop.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 50)
stop.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 245)
stop.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 70, 80)
stop.Text = "⛔ توقف"
stop.TextSize = 20
stop.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
stop.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
stop.Parent = panel

Instance.new("UICorner", stop).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)

-- وضعیت
local status = Instance.new("TextLabel")
status.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 25)
status.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 305)
status.BackgroundTransparency = 1
status.Text = "آماده"
status.TextSize = 14
status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 190, 210)
status.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
status.Parent = panel

local sending = false

-- باز کردن
open.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	panel.Visible = true
end)

-- بستن
close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	panel.Visible = false
end)

-- شروع ارسال
start.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	if sending then return end

	local text = message.Text
	local amount = tonumber(count.Text)

	if text == "" then
		status.Text = "❌ متن را وارد کن"
		return
	end

	if not amount then
		status.Text = "❌ تعداد نامعتبر است"
		return
	end

	amount = math.clamp(math.floor(amount), 1, 1000)

	local channels = TextChatService:FindFirstChild("TextChannels")
	local channel = channels and channels:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")

	if not channel then
		status.Text = "❌ چت اصلی پیدا نشد"
		return
	end

	sending = true
	start.Text = "⏳ در حال ارسال..."

	for i = 1, amount do
		if not sending then
			break
		end

		channel:SendAsync(text)
		status.Text = "ارسال " .. i .. " از " .. amount

		task.wait(0.5)
	end

	sending = false
	start.Text = "▶ شروع"

	if status.Text ~= "⛔ متوقف شد" then
		status.Text = "✅ ارسال تمام شد"
	end
end)

-- توقف
stop.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	if sending then
		sending = false
		status.Text = "⛔ متوقف شد"
		start.Text = "▶ شروع"
	end
end)
